CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set) and its organization/presentation and a distinct origin/status are explicitly recorded for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to identified content/presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content items (coordinate sets) with color attributes are listed.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are recorded separately from coordinate content, differentiating content identity from its source/status.

O.rationale: The report states coordinate-orientation and gives structured coordinate groupings, describing how content is organized/presented.
